ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ۝١
ayahs.translation: About what are they asking one another?
ayahs.translationClear: What are they asking one another about?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: About the great news[1821] -
ayahs.translationClear: About the Great Event.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: That over which they are in disagreement.
ayahs.translationClear: About which they disagree.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: No! They are going to know.
ayahs.translationClear: Surely, they will find out.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: Then, no! They are going to know.
ayahs.translationClear: Most certainly, they will find out.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا ۝٦
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
ayahs.translationClear: Did We not make the earth a cradle?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا ۝٧
ayahs.translation: And the mountains as stakes?[1822]

footnotes.1822: To stabilize the land and balance the earth.

ayahs.translationClear: And the mountains pegs?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ۝٨
ayahs.translation: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.translationClear: And created you in pairs?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا ۝٩
ayahs.translation: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.translationClear: And made your sleep for rest?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: And made the night as clothing[1823]

footnotes.1823: Covering you in darkness and providing rest.

ayahs.translationClear: And made the night a cover?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا ۝١١
ayahs.translation: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.translationClear: And made the day for livelihood?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.translationClear: And built above you seven strong ones?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.translationClear: And placed a blazing lamp?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water
ayahs.translationClear: And brought down from the clouds pouring water?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.translationClear: To produce with it grains and vegetation?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: And gardens of entwined growth.
ayahs.translationClear: And luxuriant gardens?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
ayahs.translationClear: The Day of Sorting has been appointed.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّوْرِ فَتَاْتُوْنَ اَفْوَاجًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when the Trumpet is blown, and you will come in droves.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.translationClear: And the sky is opened up, and becomes gateways.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
ayahs.translationClear: And the mountains are set in motion, and become a mirage.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.translationClear: Hell is lying in ambush.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: For the transgressors, a place of return,
ayahs.translationClear: For the oppressors, a destination.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
ayahs.translationClear: Where they will remain for eons.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا بَرْدًا وَّلَا شَرَابًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yadhooqoona feehaa bardan walaa sharaabaa
ayahs.translationClear: They will taste therein neither coolness, nor drink.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
ayahs.translationClear: Except boiling water, and freezing hail.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: An appropriate recompense.[1824]

footnotes.1824: In proportion to and comparable with their crimes.

ayahs.translationClear: A fitting requital.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا ۝٢٧
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.translationClear: For they were not anticipating any reckoning.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
ayahs.translationClear: And they denied Our signs utterly.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
ayahs.translationClear: But We have enumerated everything in writing.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."[1825]

footnotes.1825: This announcement will be made to the companions of Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: So taste! We will increase you only in suffering.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment[1826] -

footnotes.1826: Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: But for the righteous there is triumph.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.translationClear: Gardens and vineyards.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: And young women [companions] of equal age.
ayahs.translationClear: And splendid spouses, well matched.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: And a full cup.[1827]

footnotes.1827: Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

ayahs.translationClear: And delicious drinks.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ فِيْهَا لَغْوًا وَّلَا كِذّٰبًا ۚ
ayahs.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan walaa kidhdhaabaa
ayahs.translationClear: They will hear therein neither gossip, nor lies.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,[1828]

footnotes.1828: i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

ayahs.translationClear: A reward from your Lord, a fitting gift.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ‌ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: رَّبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا ۚ
ayahs.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.[1829]
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumar-rahmaani laa yamlikoona minhu khitaabaa

footnotes.1829: None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

ayahs.translationClear: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them—the Most Merciful—none can argue with Him.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا‌ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الرُّوْحُ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ صَفًّاؕࣗۙ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomur-roohu wal-malaa'ikatu saffal laa yatakallamoona illaa man adhina lahur-rahmaanu waqaala sawaabaa
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in a row. They will not speak, unless it be one permitted by the Most Merciful, and he will say what is right.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ‌ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّۚ فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ مَاٰبًا
ayahs.translation: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.[1830]
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalikal-yawmul-haqqu faman shaa'attakhadha ilaa rabbihee ma'aabaa

footnotes.1830: i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

ayahs.translationClear: That is the Day of Reality. So whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَنْذَرْنٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيْبًا࣢ۚۖ يَّوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰهُ وَيَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ تُرٰبًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth[1831] and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa andharnaakum 'adhaaban qareeban yawma yanzurul-mar'u maa qaddamat yadaahu wayaqoolul-kaafiru yaalaytanee kuntu turaabaa

footnotes.1831: i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.

ayahs.translationClear: We have warned you of a near punishment—the Day when a person will observe what his hands have produced, and the faithless will say, “Oh, I wish I were dust.”
